annotations.text:
Drawn from the app
Every card's words are ui_text.explainer's, every readout and derived row ui_text's, and every picture preview.layout's: gen.py only writes the HTML. So an artboard shows what the window would, for the same form.

Rows by kind
Profile shift for external spur and helical gears on parallel shafts; Helix angle and Hand for the helical kinds, gear B's hand following gear A's; Groove for a herringbone; Rim for a ring; Shaft angle and Mate teeth for a single bevel gear; Hands for a crossed pair; Assembly for a pair on parallel shafts.
